title: Google Authentication
task: Add Google OAuth login to an existing Next.js SaaS application. Existing users should continue to be able to log in with email and password.

title: PDF Upload
task: Build a file upload feature that allows users to upload PDF documents and view their upload history.

title: Stripe Subscriptions
task: Add Stripe subscriptions to our Next.js SaaS application. Users should be able to upgrade, downgrade, and cancel their subscription.

title: Pagination
task: Add pagination to the customer list in our web application. Users should be able to move between pages and see how many results exist.

title: Password Reset
task: Add a password reset flow so users can request a reset email and securely create a new password.

title: Email Notifications
task: Add email notifications when an important account event occurs. Users should be able to manage their notification preference.

title: Image Upload
task: Allow users to upload profile images and replace their existing profile image.

title: Role Permissions
task: Add role-based permissions to an internal application. Administrators should have access to functionality that regular users do not.

title: Search
task: Add search functionality to an existing product catalog so users can find products by name.

title: Payment Webhook
task: Add payment webhook handling to update an application's order status when the payment provider confirms a successful payment.

title: Authentication Migration
task: Migrate the existing authentication system to a new authentication provider without breaking currently authenticated users or existing accounts.
